propositions: Five function-scoped git/rebar fixture builders repeatedly construct equivalent invariant topologies from scratch for every consumer, generating 103.416 aggregate worker-seconds across the top five test modules in Verify run 31846417650.
Runtime instrumentation proves setup dominates these fixtures: real store initialization was 12-23x slower than isolated-copy relocation, while test-body work remained fast.

Per-test copies must have independent environment identity, signing keys, worktree paths, refs, and object stores; a prior defect left asymmetric .opcert-key material copied verbatim, violating isolation contracts.
Behavioral isolation sentinels verify half-rewritten pointers, bare worktree repair, shared refs/objects, identity/key sharing, virgin templates, and mutable config state remain detectable defects.
Session-scoped templates with per-test copies reduce fixture overhead while preserving all existing test assertions and initialization/recovery from-scratch contracts.
No production behavior, dependency, assertion, or test coverage changed; all 125 affected tests passed; full default and integration selectors passed without skipping or weakening any test.
